cacheLayout: generations/<gen> immutable + staging/<gen> + atomic active.json + lkg.json
activation: rename staging -> generations/<gen>, verify, write lkg pointer, atomically replace active.json, prune
recovery: invalid active pointer falls back to verified lkg
invalid generation falls back to empty cache
crash before pointer swap leaves old generation active
singleFlight: global ensure lock after a lock-free cached fast path; per-module call count == 1 in 8-way concurrent ensure and parallel startup

lazy_dispatch: lazy dispatcher materializes only paired modules and prepares via quickjs

networkFetcher: converter::http::HttpsFetcher: HTTPS only, trusted manifest host, same-host redirects (max 3), 15 s connect/read/write timeout, 16 MiB response cap; SHA-256/size verified by ModuleCache; not exercised against a real mirror
